commits.message: F-001: add landing page and base layout.
C-001: add a local CI-equivalent test command.

tests.summary: Python 3.12.10, compile app, compile tests, pytest -q: 18 passed in 2.87s. ci_local: passed.

tests.command: uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000, then curl.exe against a temp SQLite file
tests.summary: GET /health 200 application/json content-length 15. GET / returned landing-title, landing-register, nav-register, and brand-link. GET /register returned register-form and register-submit. POST valid registration 303 Location /account-created. GET /account-created contained registration-success. POST invalid registration 400 with register-error. GET /missing-page 404. Stored user smoke@example.com role employee; password_hash started with pbkdf2_sha256$600000$ and did not contain the password.
Built zfg-leave-app-leave-app from python:3.12.10-slim-bookworm after Docker Desktop was started. An earlier attempt failed because the Docker engine pipe was not available.

tests.command: docker compose up -d, then curl.exe http://127.0.0.1:8000/health and POST /register
tests.summary: Container logged 'Database schema is ready.' and uvicorn on 0.0.0.0:8000. GET /health body was {"status":"ok"}. Inspect health status became healthy. POST registration 303 Location /account-created. ./data/leave.db stored container@example.com role employee with a pbkdf2_sha256 hash that did not contain the password. Container was then stopped with docker compose down and the smoke database file was deleted.

notes: Baseline specification commit, not a ticket: 89af2a0aaf47a0356a5beb04cd8da4c9c6529ca0.

Alembic is C-004 on day 03. Day 01 creates missing tables with python -m app.db_init (SQLAlchemy create_all). It does not drop or alter existing tables. uvicorn app.main:app does not initialize the database. The container command python -m app.serve initializes, then starts uvicorn.

GET /health exists because the product contract requires it. C-003 on day 02 is still the fuller README quickstart. The README currently has the install, init, run, and test commands needed for day 01.

No demo account is seeded. C-002 is day 03. Public registration always stores role employee and ignores any posted role. Sign-in is F-003 on day 02, so registration ends on /account-created without a session.
Registration accepts ASCII email addresses only.
No intentional defect was introduced. B-001 is eligible false and its related feature is not implemented.
Python is pinned to 3.12.10. This machine previously had only Python 3.10.6; 3.12.10 was installed for local tests. The image is python:3.12.10-slim-bookworm.
FastAPI is constructed with telemetry auto_configure false. opentelemetry-api is installed because FastAPI 0.165.0 depends on it. No OTLP exporter package is installed.

Stable selectors: brand-link, nav-home, nav-register, landing-title, landing-summary, landing-register, register-form, register-email, register-display-name, register-password, register-password-confirm, register-submit, register-error, registration-success, registration-success-home, database-unavailable, database-unavailable-register, not-found, not-found-home.
Routes: GET /health, GET /, GET /register, POST /register, GET /account-created, HTML 404 for unknown paths.
